claim_ceiling: This stable package starts from the migration-selected Artifact Type contract, applies any recorded owner-review refinement, and binds its semantic dependencies to admitted Definitions. It does not admit the Artifact Type, admit any instance, authenticate fixture claims, integrate a consumer, or activate behavior.
distinct_validation_purpose: Records one attributable execution of an exact Experiment Design while preserving its Project, Goal, optional Research Inquiry trace, and optional Product evaluation context together with actual inputs, environment, interventions, deviations, observations, measurements, timing, and stop state.

four_facets.classification: Candidate Experiment Run with explicit source bindings.
four_facets.human_continuation: Generated RECORD.md and the complete-model review explain the revised contract, realistic example, dependencies, and claim limits.

name: Experiment Run

orthogonality_rules.statement: Every run binds an exact design version, preserves its Project, Goal, optional Research trace, and optional Product evaluation anchors, and records actual conditions separately from planned conditions.
Completion, observations, measurements, and an evidence set do not become a Finding or decision.
